children: Canfor Corp (T.CFP) Hit a 52-Week High of $16.31. Recent mill closures have been "gut-wrenching" as the forestry industry faces tough market conditions, the chief executive of Canfor Corp. said.

CMX Gold (C.CXC) Hit a 52-Week High of 30 cents. CMX is a junior mining company with a silver-lead-zinc property in the United States of America. The company's focus is on the development of its wholly-owned Clayton Silver Property located in Idaho, with the primary focus being to determine the feasibility of reactivating the mine. Geographically, it operates in Canada and the United States.
Interfor Corporation (T.IFP) Hit a 52-Week High of $14.99. Interfor confirmed plans this summer to move corporate support functions to the United States from its Burnaby, B.C. headquarters.

Max Power Mining Cor (C.MAXX) Hit a 52-Week High of $3.63. MAX Power Mining provided the following exploration and operational update from its Lawson Natural Hydrogen Discovery in south-central Saskatchewan where the Company has delineated Canada's first subsurface Natural Hydrogen system.

RESAAS Services Inc. (V.RSS) Hit a 52-Week High of 64 cents. RESAAS Services today announced that it has been invited to present on "Beyond the Ticker," a live investor event hosted by Bruce Campbell, Portfolio Manager at StoneCastle Investment Management.

Surge Energy Inc (T.SGY) Hit a 52-Week High of $12.41. Surge confirms that a cash dividend to be paid on October 15, in respect of September production, for the shareholders of record on September 30 will be $0.043333 per share.
Yangarra Resources Ltd (T.YGR) Hit a 52-Week High of $1.63. Late in July, Yangarra declared Q2 GAAP EPS of C$0.11, revenue of C$43.2M.
